newsitem.title: MEXICO: TELMEX'S CHICO PARDO NOT TO QUIT - SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: TELMEX'S CHICO PARDO NOT TO QUIT - SOURCE.

text.p: The resignation of Fernando Chico Pardo as head of Grupo Financiero Inbursa will not be followed by his brother Jaime Chico Pardo, director general of Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex), an Inbursa source said.
The source said Fernando Chico Pardo's decision was taken because he wanted to pursue private business interests, and that he would leave "on the best of terms". Jaime was not quitting with him.

Mexican business magnate Carlos Slim is chairman of the board of Grupo Inbursa, as well as chairman of Telmex and Grupo Carso, Mexico's largest holding company. The two Chico Pardo brothers are considered among his closest advisors.
